text: The Chair of the Human Resources Committee will update the Board on Human Resources matters, including a review of compensation for Toronto Atmospheric Fund staff. Additional materials with recommendations related to the compensation structure for Toronto Atmospheric Fund employees will be provided to the Board for consideration. These matters will require a closed session discussion, as they relate to personal information about identifiable individuals and compensation considerations.

That the Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Received the report (November 1, 2022) from the Chair, Human Resources Committee for information. 2. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (November 1, 2022) from the Chair, Human Resources Committee remain confidential in its entirety, as it is about employee negotiations.
